title: Bellman Optimal Stepsize Straightening of Flow-Matching Models
tldr_zh: 动态规划求 K 步最优非均匀 Euler 步长，再按步长把速度场拉成分段直线；6 NFE 下 256×256 数据 FID 约为 reflow 一半，LoRA 2% 参数即可
tldr_en: Dynamic programming finds Bellman-optimal non-uniform Euler stepsizes; retraining the velocity along them halves 6-NFE FID vs reflow on 256x256 datasets with only 12k iterations or 2% LoRA params.
key_numbers: Bellman stepsizes alone (no training), CelebA-HQ 8 NFE FID 109.42 -> 49.80 (Table 1)
BOSS-6 vs Uniform-Reflow vs Distill-6-Reflow at 6 NFE: CelebA-HQ 18.67 / 43.57 / 34.56; LSUN-Church 17.43 / 40.45 / 34.52; CIFAR-10 4.80 / 4.33 / 4.35 (Table 2)
Finetuning 12,000 iterations, batch 15, 3.6-14.2 h on one RTX A5000 (Appendix A)
LoRA-4 trains 2.02% params, CelebA-HQ FID 36.70 vs full-rank 33.86 at 175k iters (Table 8, Fig. 8)
Stepsize search ~115 s for 256x256 datasets, K_max=100, N=100 (Table 3)
Optimal stepsizes small at both ends, e.g. CelebA-HQ K=8: [0.02,0.05,0.11,0.17,0.21,0.20,0.16,0.08] (Table 5)
